descriptions.text: Inspired by a mountain getaway, the Scenic Adventure Stamp Set captures the spirit of the great outdoors. Build a beautiful forest by repeatedly stamping the evergreen trees or use the flowers to create an alpine meadow. The multipurpose texture stamp can represent water, ground, or tree bark simply by changing the ink color. With these highly customizable image and sentiment stamps, you can send just the right greeting to the adventurer in your life! DETAILS - 13 photopolymer stamps - Suggested clear blocks (sold separately): b, d, e, h - Ask your demonstrator about coordinating products

Get inspired by the beauty and serenity of the outdoors with the Scenic Adventure Dies. Cut out nature-themed images like evergreen trees, majestic mountains, and a moonlit night sky to create layered scenes perfect for scrapbooking and card making. The border dies are open on the bottom, allowing you to choose the length of your pieces for customized layering options.

Celebrate life’s journeys with the Scenic Adventure Bundle! Use these coordinating dies and stamps to create majestic mountain landscapes, complete with evergreen trees, wildflowers, and a starry night sky. The border dies are open at the bottom, allowing you to customize the length of each piece for a variety of layered scenes. This nature-inspired set is perfect for a scrapbook page commemorating a cherished family getaway or a handmade card for the outdoor enthusiast in your life. DETAILS - Includes the Scenic Adventure Stamp Set and Scenic Adventure Dies - 13 photopolymer stamps - Suggested clear blocks (sold separately): b, d, e, h - 11 dies - Largest die: 5" x 1-3/4" (12.7 x 4.4 cm) - Use with a Stampin’ Cut & Emboss Machine (sold separately)Note: Retired bundles may contain items that are not retired.

Let our stamps do the talking with the More Messages Stamp Set. This all-purpose sentiment stamp helps you express yourself with common greetings and phrases that suit most occasions, from heartfelt birthday greetings and missed connections to encouraging words and good-luck wishes. The sentiments are on a single stamp—use them together or stamp once and trim!

If you’re looking for all-purpose dies to accentuate common stamp greetings and expressions, give our More Messages Die a try. Use the die cuts as a base for mounting sentiments and cutout images or as the backdrop for cards, crafts, gifts, and tags. Say it with style using the More Messages Die.

Sometimes the perfect words just don’t come to mind. Our More Messages Bundle is here to help you find the right expression for any occasion. This versatile bundle includes our More Messages Stamp Set with a variety of common greetings and sentiments, along with the coordinating More Messages Dies that create stunning backdrops for your text.Note: Retired bundles may contain items that are not retired.

Celebrate cherished friendships with the Sentimental Framing Stamp Set! Featuring a beautiful pairing of simple serif and elegant script fonts, this set offers heartfelt sentiments that add a personal touch to your card making projects. Perfect for expressing gratitude, encouragement, or just because, these timeless stamps will be a go-to for your creative projects.

The Sentimental Framing Dies feature simple and versatile frames, perfect for card making, scrapbooking, and other paper crafting projects. Each die includes a unique dot-piercing design. Ideal for highlighting photos, sentiments, or embellishments, this set is a must-have for any paper crafter!

Meet the Sentimental Framing Bundle, featuring sentiment-only stamps and versatile frame dies! The heartfelt stamps pair beautifully with the pierced frames, for gorgeous handmade cards and scrapbook layouts.Note: Retired bundles may contain items that are not retired.

Oink oink—it’s a party! A card made with the Party Piggy Stamp Set is sure to delight any birthday girl or boy on their big day! Stamp each piece separately to create the playful barnyard buddy, then add your favorite sentiment. Don’t forget piggy’s party hat!

Capture the fun of movie night with the Poppin’ By Stamp Set! Combine playful popcorn people and lighthearted, punny greetings for handmade cards and tags that are sure to get rave reviews. The bold solid image artwork is ideal for a variety of inking techniques. What could be "butter" than that?

Create playful popcorn characters bursting with personality with the Poppin’ By Dies! Dress up your popcorn people with sneakers or 3D glasses, and add a film strip to your project for that old-fashioned cinematic feel. Some dies partially cut the popcorn pieces to add scene-stealing fine details!

Popcorn is the star of the show with the Poppin’ By Bundle! Use these coordinating stamps and dies to create playful popcorn people, complete with tiny shoes and glasses. Add a lighthearted sentiment for a fun handmade card or tag that’s sure to be a hit with the movie lover in your life!Note: Retired bundles may contain items that are not retired.

Add some ribbon, a cute label or tag, and share with your favorite globe trekker.

This thin, flexible twine isn't bulky, so it lies nice and flat on a memory keeping project. It's also great to tie around a card or to tousle behind an embellishment. Its thin size makes it ideal to tie on a tag for a gift or a treat package. With three bright colors, you can add a pop of color to all your projects!

descriptions.text: Combine your love of travel with your love of crafting with the On the Go Suite Collection. The travel-themed imagery in this suite is great for both card makers and scrapbookers alike. The versatile patterned paper includes images that can be used as full sheets, cut down for smaller projects like cards or tags, or be used for journaling on a scrapbook page. Add the perfect sentiment using the stamp set and coordinating dies. If you're in the mood to give a travel-themed gift, fill the prescored and ready to decorate and assemble suitcase-shaped treat boxes. Embellish all your projects using the brightly colored puffy stickers, and tie everything off with some pretty twine. Also available in French.
